_about: Machine-readable map of Guava's 'New API App' form, for an agent filling it on a user's behalf. Observed 2026-11-03 at https://guavahealth.com/api-portal/apps (button 'New App' opens a dialog). Labels are the accessible names; checkboxes are role=checkbox buttons (not <input>), so click them, don't set .checked. Re-verify labels before relying on this file: if a label is missing, the form has changed.

portal.submit: button 'Create App' (type=submit). Irreversible-ish: the user confirms first.

text_fields.label: Redirect URIs
text_fields.note: Must match GUAVA_REDIRECT_URI exactly. Guava is https-only; scripts/guava.py serves this with a self-signed cert, or use auth --paste.

text_fields.label: Purpose
text_fields.placeholder: What your API app does and why it needs the scopes you request
text_fields.template: Personal/family self-management tool run by the account holder on their own machine (confidential client, secret stored locally). Used by {holder} managing their own profile{dependents_clause} on a Guava {plan} plan: logging medication doses (med_usage), symptoms, mood/energy, journal notes, temperature, weight and other readings, and reading back logs, sleep, activity, vitals and clinical records for review and summaries. Single-user, no third-party data sharing.

top_level_checkboxes.label: Long-lived background access
top_level_checkboxes.why: Without it no refresh token is issued and every grant dies after expires_in (3600 s).

top_level_checkboxes.label: Patient ID for this connection
top_level_checkboxes.why: Returns the FHIR Patient id of the granted profile in token responses; distinguishes holder vs dependent grants.

scope_grid._columns: Each row has a 'Read' and a 'Write' checkbox. Read alone -> .rs; Write alone -> .cud; both -> .cruds.

Body composition.row: Body composition (fat %, muscle, bone, water, lean mass)

family-manager.description: Holder + dependents, log and review everything. Read+Write on all non-clinical rows, Read on all clinical rows. FHIR is read-only, so clinical Write boxes stay empty. Produces reference/scopes-full.txt (44 scopes).

medication-logger.description: Just dose logging and medication review.

not_on_the_form: There is no family/dependent/household scope. Dependents are chosen per grant on the consent screen; see docs/family-and-dependents.md.
The docs list a 'profile' scope for GET /v1/me, but the form has no 'profile' checkbox (2026-11-03).
verify_after_filling: Read the read-only textbox labelled 'Resulting scope string'. It lists one scope per line; compare it with the preset.
